outcome: Help institutions connect programmes to explicit skills, labour demand, credentials, and improvement actions.
overview: Programme teams reconcile curriculum documents, skills language, employer demand and graduate outcomes by hand, and the work is slow enough that programmes drift out of step with the labour market. This solution extracts learning outcomes and assessment evidence, maps them to an approved skills taxonomy, and compares that map with governed labour-market sources whose dates and licences are visible. Every gap carries a confidence score and a trace back to its source; academics accept, edit or reject each one, and nothing rewrites a programme automatically. A six-to-ten-week pilot delivers an expert-approved skills map and a prioritised improvement backlog with a named owner for each accepted gap.

benefits.text: Cut the manual effort of mapping a programme to skills and labour demand by a target 40% against the current review cycle
benefits.source: Redington Education catalogue and; to validate against the institution’s own review-hour baseline
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Target to validate on the pilot programmes — depends on how structured the existing curriculum documents are

benefits.text: Trace every skills claim and every identified gap back to a dated, licensed source an academic reviewer can open
benefits.source: Reference design — provenance, source dates and confidence scores are structural to the mapping output
benefits.limits: Traceability is structural; the quality of the underlying labour-market data varies by market and occupation

benefits.text: Give provosts and quality offices a repeatable, versioned evidence base for programme, credential and portfolio decisions
benefits.source: Reference design — programme maps are versioned and refreshable on a fixed cadence
benefits.limits: Usefulness depends on the institution running the academic review governance the design assumes

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (UAE, KSA); curriculum, assessment and graduate-outcome data stay inside the institution’s tenancy, and licensed market data stays within its licence terms

notFor.situation: Curriculum outcomes exist only as unstructured prose with no module or assessment structure
notFor.why: Extraction and mapping need identifiable learning outcomes and assessment evidence to anchor to; free prose yields low-confidence mappings that waste academic review time

notFor.situation: The institution wants the system to redesign programmes or set curriculum automatically
notFor.why: The design surfaces gaps for academic review and accreditation governance; programme change remains an academic decision by policy

notFor.situation: No licensed or governed labour-market data source for the target market
notFor.why: Demand comparison without rights-cleared, dated sources produces claims the institution cannot defend to employers or accreditors

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the institution owns the taxonomy decision, academic review and any programme change · Duration: 6–10 weeks pilot; 12–20 weeks to scaled faculty deployment
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, data engineer, applied NLP engineer, learning-design consultant; customer programme director, careers lead, quality office reviewer, data owner · Support model: Business-hours support aligned to academic review cycles; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor and data-source escalation
1) Discovery, source inventory and rights mapping
2) Taxonomy selection and local extension
3) Extraction and mapping build with confidence calibration
4) Academic review cycles on the pilot programmes
5) Gap prioritisation and action assignment
6) Refresh runbook and handover
deliverables: Agreed extraction and mapping quality thresholds met on the pilot programmes
Every mapping and gap traceable to a dated, licensed source
Academic panel approval recorded for the published programme map
Version control demonstrated, with superseded maps retrievable
Refresh process repeated end to end by the customer team
Uncertainty and low-confidence mappings documented rather than hidden
effort: 6–10 weeks pilot; 12–20 weeks to scaled faculty deployment
languages: English delivery; Arabic and English curriculum documents supported for extraction and mapping
